In this writ petition, the petitioner is questioning the order dated 03.07.2023 in O.S.No.2/2019 (Annexure-E) passed by the Court of Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC at Bidar, allowing the application filed under Order VI Rule 17 of Code of Civil Procedure.

entities.text: Court of Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC at Bidar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Brief facts are that, the petitioners are the defendants in O.S.No.2/2019 filed by respondent herein seeking relief of declaration and mandatory injunction.

The respondent herein had filed application under Order VI Rule 17 of Code of Civil Procedure, seeking to incorporate paragraph-9(a) with regard to Section 24 (2) of the Right to NC: 2023:KHC-K:6379 Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 3.

entities.text: Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Having taken note of the finding recorded by the Trial Court, the application seeking amendment was filed after the matter stood posted for cross-examination of DW.1.

It is well established principle in law that, the scope of proviso to Order VI Rule 17 of Code of Civil Procedure, shall be kept in mind while dealing with the application seeking amendment of the pleadings.
That apart, the plea raised by the plaintiff recourse to Section 24(2) of the Act cannot be considered in the suit proceedings.
4. In that view of the matter, the writ petition is allowed.
The impugned order dated 03.07.2023 passed in O.S.No.2/2019 by the Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Bidar is set aside.

Consequently, the application filed by the plaintiff under Order VI Rule 17 of Code of Civil Procedure is dismissed.
